{{Character Infobox |color={{kitakami color}} |corecolor={{kitakami color light}} |bordercolor={{kitakami color dark}} |name=Caretaker |jname=管理人 |jtranslit=Kanrinin |tmname=Caretaker |image=Scarlet Violet Caretaker.png |size=150px |caption=The caretaker |gender=Male |hometown=[[Mossui Town]] |region=[[Kitakami]] |eyes=Light gray |hair=Light gray |relatives=[[Shizune]] (daughter) }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{kitakami color light}} |gen={{gen|IX}} |games={{pkmn|Scarlet and Violet|Scarlet, Violet}} }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{kitakami color light}} |series={{aniseries|HZ}} |debut=''[[HZ069|Roy is Crocalor, and Crocalor is Roy!]]'' |jpva=Ken Uo |enva=N/A }} |} The '''caretaker''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|管理人|かんりにん}}''' ''Caretaker'') is a [[non-player character]] introduced in [[The Teal Mask]] in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}. He gives the {{player}} their assignment on their school trip to [[Kitakami]]. ==In the core series games== The caretaker is a member of the [[Mossui Town]] community center in [[Kitakami]]. He accommodates the player and other students from [[Paldea]] during their visit, and he also manages local tourism efforts. He gives the player a [[Roto-Stick]] on the first day of orienteering to help them take pictures of the signboards around Kitakami. He holds the history and values of Kitakami with high regard, but is shown to be able to change his outlook after learning about the truth between the [[Loyal Three]] and {{p|Ogerpon}}. After the player catches Ogerpon, the caretaker can be found at [[Kitakami Hall]] requesting donations for the "We Love Loyalty Plaza" drive, an initiative that he set up to repair the Loyal Three's monument at [[Loyalty Plaza]]. He accepts {{pdollar}}10,000 or {{pdollar}}100,000 donations at a time, and returns the favor with one [[Pretty Feather]] per {{pdollar}}10,000 donated. After [[Mollie]] helped [[Shizune|his daughter]] with some foot injuries, the Caretaker decided to allow the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] to go to [[Crystal Pool]], much to [[Carmine]]'s surprise. The Caretaker reappeared in a flashback in ''[[HZ123|Mochi Mayhem!]]'' as [[Diana]] and [[Hamber]] visited Mossui Town. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{fire color}}|bordercolor={{fire color dark}} |ja=魚建 ''Ken Uo'' |he=גלעד קלטר ''Gilad Kletter'' |it=Federico Danti }} {{-}} ==In the TCG== [[File:CaretakerTwilightMasquerade203.jpg|200px|thumb|Ultra rare print of Caretaker]] {{main|Caretaker (Twilight Masquerade 144)}} '''Caretaker''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Crimson Haze}} expansion and the English {{TCG|Twilight Masquerade}} expansion, with artwork by [[Akira Komayama]]. An {{TCG|ultra rare}} version with artwork by the same illustrator was released in the same sets. This card lets the player draw 2 cards. Referencing the caretaker's role in the community center, if the {{TCG|Stadium card}} {{TCG ID|Twilight Masquerade|Community Center|146}} is in play, the Caretaker card is shuffled back into the deck after it is used instead of discarded. {{-}} ==In other languages== {{Langtable|color={{kitakami color}}|bordercolor={{kitakami color light}} |zh_yue=管理員 ''Gúnléihyùhn'' |zh_cmn=管理員 ''Guǎnlǐyuán'' |fr=Intendant |de=Verwalter |id=Pengurus |it=Responsabile |ko=관리인 ''Gwalli'in'' |pl=Nadzorca |pt_br=Zelador |es=Encargado
